content.text: Do you want to talk about it? Like a story about what you went through, etc.
Once I get back yeah. If that’s cool
For sure
I don’t know what they’re doing. Some teams have announced players without their names
Okay cool 😎
Yeah the player has to consent to it
I feel like something’s gotta be coming, just because the nature of this whole thing. It’s not like a broken leg
But teeter told me not to tell anyone
I know and I’m not working it anymore. But you’re not the only one that hasn’t been around
So teams have announced that players have tested positive without using their names
Yeah that makes sense
I was shocked how low the league total was
I’m just not buying into that number yet
Lol true
Especially with the testing problems they’re having right now. I just can’t trust them
It’s almost like they spent so long arguing over money and forgot about this whole pandemic thing. They should’ve had that stuff done long before the money
You are correct. It’s been a shit sho
Ok, so you didn’t consent for them to disclose your name, I’m guessing.
Have you really only told me, Boyd and your parents? Lol
Wait what happened
Nothing happened I’m just trying to work this problem out in my head
Yeah I mean I’m sure Boyd told teammates that were asking
Ok so what I’m getting at is
Mckosky texted me today and I just said I can’t say anything
Teams have announced players have tested positive without saying their names. If they get consent, they have said their names.
So what are the Tigers waiting for
Oh I gotcha. Have the tigers announced anything
No
Oh I gotcha
And I guess, this isn’t a broken arm or something, you know?
Yeah I feel you
But this stuff is way high-level, serious so they probably have to run it through a lot of lawyers and stuff, I dunno.
Yeah there’s like laws
But also, think of it this way
That’s why I texted you about when you were throwing because on day 3, I was like hmmm
Yeah I feel like it’s obvious
And so, would you want us to put ou there that we haven’t seen Norris, Tarik Skubal, Faedo or Paredes?
Hmmmm I wonder what’s going on with them kinda thing
That’s not really my call lol
I’m not saying *you*
But you as if you were the Tigers
Because I feel like that puts everyone in a tough spot, kinda thing

When really, they could just announce that players have tested positive in the most vague terms and then not answer questions about it. And at that point, the reporters might not even put the players out there.
I dunno. Out of your jurisdiction, I know. I was just curious
Yeah I’m not really sure what their plan is. I’m just hoping to get a couple negatives and it’s all over
When do you test again
I did today
So then if you get another negative
Apparently the one yesterday doesn’t count
You gotta get 2 straight, right?
How long between
Yeah
24 hrs
So they test again tomorrow?
I get results on this one tomorrow
Ok. Man, this has gotta be killing you, everyone at camp already
Correct. I am losing my mind
Especially at 100 percent for the past week
No doubt. I’m not missing any throwing tho so I’ll be fine
Yeah
